hook.name: PhiEthHooks
hook.description: A 1:1 ETH/phiEth custom-curve hook that intercepts swaps via beforeSwap to bypass the AMM entirely. It takes input from the pool manager, converts via phiEth.deposit() or phiEth.withdraw(), settles the output, and returns a BeforeSwapDelta consuming the full swap amount. Adding liquidity directly to the pool is blocked.
